nodes.label: Serve Request Hardening (S-156 / 0.5.1 impl A)
nodes.rationale: Hardens the local HTTP API boundary with no-Origin cross-site sec-fetch-site 403 rejection, source/name shape validation (400), 1 MiB transport body cap (413), global token-bucket rate limiter (429), serialized capped spawn queue (503), timing-safe Bearer compare, generic 500 bodies, outbound fetch timeouts, and segment-encoded GitHub trees URLs.
